name: maxmin_complex
expr: mx = max(z, 1); mn = min(z, 1); t = max(1+0i, 0+1i); aa = max(w, u); ab = min(w, u); na = max(complex(NaN,2), 3+4i); rf = max(complex(-3,0), 1); cl = max(0, min(1, 0.3+0.4i));
comment: Binary (elementwise) complex max/min: compare by |z| (modulus), ties broken by angle(z); a NaN-component operand is omitted (omitnan is the max/min default). NO all-real fallback in the binary form (unlike the reduction): max(complex(-3,0),1)=-3 because |-3|=3>1. max(z,1)=[3+4i,1]; min(z,1)=[1,0.2-0.1i]; max(1+0i,0+1i)=0+1i (angle tie); max([1+1i 2-2i],[2+0i 1+1i])=[2,2-2i]; max(complex(NaN,2),3+4i)=3+4i; clamp max(0,min(1,0.3+0.4i))=0.3+0.4i. bugs/math/maxmin-complex.md.
